subset_policy: Only objects referenced by this project are vendored, plus the parent tactics required to interpret them.
remapped_identifier_notes: Clearing Windows event logs is mapped to T1685.005, superseding the earlier T1070.001 identifier.
Clearing Linux or macOS system logs is mapped to T1685.006.
Defensive tool impairment is mapped to T1685.
Host firewall modification is mapped to T1686.
defensive_object_policy: Detection Strategy, Analytic, and Data Component identifiers are recorded only when they were present in the pinned extraction. Official object names are vendored only where the extraction supplied them; otherwise the name field is null and no name is invented.

legacy_data_sources.usage: Not used as a primary mapping anywhere in this project.
